note: Re-judged 2026-10-23 (independent auditor, after 9242dcd57b). RFC 7606 Section 5.3: "The length of the MP_UNREACH_NLRI attribute is less than 3, or the length of the MP_REACH_NLRI attribute is less than 5." Only test/plugin/rfc7606-reset.ci changed: its MP_REACH_NLRI of length 2 now must produce the exact NOTIFICATION 3/9 whose Data is that attribute (800E020001), produced by rfc7606.go validateMPAttrLength through MPAttributeErrorNotification; the exact Data proves the length rule fired rather than a neighbouring one. The isolated boundary negative TestRFC7606MPReachLengthFourIsIncorrect (length 4, FlowSpec so no next-hop rule applies, exact SessionReset, AttrCode 14, "length 4 < 5") and the positive TestRFC7606MPMinimumLengthsAccepted (MP_REACH 5 and MP_UNREACH 3 give ActionNone) are unchanged and ran green. The MP_UNREACH < 3 clause has its negative only under other rows (TestRFC7606MPUnreachTooShort, tagged RFC7606-3.j-1; TestRFC4760IncorrectMPAttributeResetsTheSession, tagged RFC4760-7-1), both exact SessionReset with AttrCode 15; adding an RFC7606-5.3-6 negative tag there is reported as a finding. Verdict stands.
